text:
anna: Quick thread to lock down scope for a customer-driven private pilot. Need alignment on runtime prewarm, infra reserved slots, and KMS acceptance. Target: ~6 weeks. Who can own interfaces?
diego: Runtime can prototype a prewarm path (serialized KV + primed model weights). ETA proto 10 business days. Need perf target and an API shape.
mira: Infra: region-us-west has limited spare. We can carve 6 soft-reserved slots now; hard-reserve needs node add (~3w). Will need a fallback rule to hosted pool.
ryan: Security: KMS must decrypt tenant keys at boot. HSM optional for pilot but we need audit log retention and rotation policy. ETA: checklist in 4 business days.
anna: Proposed minimal acceptance: 1) warm p95 < 300ms for 64-token prompts, 2) fallback routing defined (<=5% routed to hosted under normal load), 3) KMS decrypt at boot plus per-key audit logs retained 30d.
diego: Agreed on perf target for proto. I'll add a small perf harness and include numbers. Config draft coming tonight.
mira: Fallback: router prefers private slots, falls back to hosted when reserved_slots_util > 85% for >10s. Emit metric reserved_pressure. Product to confirm acceptable fallback %.
ryan: Product asks fallback <=3% for pilot. Rollback criteria: if fallback p99 > 1s or error rate > 0.5% then pause pilot.
anna: Owners: runtime=diego (ETA May 12), infra=mira (carve 6 slots by Apr 14, node add by May 5), security=ryan (ETA Apr 10), product=anna (acceptance tests by Apr 9).
diego: Example config I'll post: ```yaml
reserved_slots:
  tenant: acme
  count: 6
  prewarm_ttl: 10m
  fallback:
    threshold_pct: 85
    sustain_secs: 10
    route: hosted_pool
```
mira: I'll add capacity dashboard and an alert for reserved_pressure > 90%. schedulers-bot: Meeting created: "Private pilot handoff" Tue 10:00 PT invites: @anna @diego @mira @ryan.
anna: Thanks all. I'll update the roadmap ticket with owners, dates, and acceptance. Ping here with any blockers. :thumbsup:
